projects.name: KahinPAY – Offline Distributed UPI Payment Engine
projects.description: Offline-first distributed UPI payment engine where transactions propagate across devices over a simulated BLE mesh via an epidemic gossip protocol and settle idempotently when any node regains internet connectivity.
key_highlights: Built an offline-first payment system where transactions spread between devices over a simulated BLE mesh using an epidemic gossip protocol, then settle through any device that regains internet access.
Secured transactions with client-side ECDSA (secp256r1) signatures and hybrid RSA-2048 + AES-256-GCM encryption, ensuring intermediary devices cannot spoof or tamper with payloads.
Built an idempotent settlement engine using Redis atomic operations (SETNX, 24h TTL) with an in-memory fallback, preventing replay attacks and duplicate ledger updates.

projects.name: PetPuja – AI Dining Agent
projects.description: Architected an autonomous dining and culinary order orchestration agent separating probabilistic LLM reasoning from deterministic backend execution.
key_highlights: Architected an autonomous dining agent using LangGraph, FastAPI, and Groq, cleanly separating probabilistic LLM intent classification from deterministic backend nodes (order validation, cooking, serving, and inventory mutations).

Implemented Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) transactional workflows using LangGraph's interrupt() primitive and MemorySaver checkpointer, enabling pre-confirmation order modifications, proactive culinary pairing suggestions, and dynamic piece-level pricing arithmetic for multi-item portions.

Engineered a self-healing fault-tolerant execution graph with per-item retry tracking, automated receipt adjustment ($0.00 charged) for partially fulfilled orders, and a multi-model fallback cascade to eliminate rate-limit downtime.

projects.name: Autonomous Candidate AI Copilot & Full-Stack Platform
projects.description: Production full-stack GenAI platform featuring an autonomous Copilot with real-time SSE streaming, candidate grounding, multimodal voice STT/TTS, and automated JD fit analysis.
key_highlights: Architected a production full-stack GenAI platform featuring an autonomous Copilot powered by FastAPI and Groq, engineering real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming to achieve ~300ms time-to-first-token (TTFT) with zero-hallucination candidate grounding.

Engineered production-grade security & reliability by implementing sliding-window conversational memory, IP-based rate limiting, and robust prompt-injection defenses; deployed with automated CI/CD on Vercel with serverless FastAPI.

Built multimodal client capabilities in React 18, integrating hands-free Voice STT/TTS (Web Speech API), bilingual English/Hindi localization, and an automated Job Description Fit Matcher for real-time skills gap analysis.
